newsitem.title: USA: Sheffield acquires Camelot for 680,000 shares.
newsitem.headline: Sheffield acquires Camelot for 680,000 shares.

text.p: Sheffield Medical Technologies Inc said Monday that it has acquired Camelot Pharmacal LLC, a privately held pharmaceutical company, for 680,000 shares of Sheffield stock.
The company said certain members of Camelot's management team have joined Sheffield and been granted options to acquire 1.2 million common shares at the market price at the time of acquisition.
Camelot stock traded mid-Monday afternoon at 2-3/4.

Camelot's product portfolio consists of options to acquire late-stage drug development opportunities in a range of therapeutic areas. Sheffield is a diversified healthcare company that develops and commercializes therapies and delivery systems.
